self.reason: Provides the app its own identity (app_id) and access to tarball entries; used by the platform runtime and reserved for future static-file serving from the app bundle.

server.reason: Serves the embedded HTML/JS/CSS frontend at GET / and handles all /api/* JSON endpoints (list, search, source discovery, thumb proxy).

index_db.reason: Runs paginated SELECT and COUNT queries against the installed-app index, with FTS5 full-text search and tag-join filtering, to back the GET /api/apps endpoint.

stdout.reason: Injected write function for CLI subcommand output (list-apps, search); falls back to io.write when absent.

stderr.reason: Injected write function for CLI error messages; falls back to io.stderr:write when absent.
